state.model_text: ProgramReadiness keeps a compact latest-assessment pointer, decision admission/seal generation, latest management decision and permanent approved Type I entry pointer; reducers never read content or projections.
state.code_behavior: TypeIEntryDecisionRecorded carries intent, decision content ref and proofs but not the outcome (approve, approve_with_exceptions, defer), which is only inside immutable content. The aggregate resets its entry decision on every adoption and holds no program-wide approved entry pointer; the already-entered check reads a projection in the admission handler.

premise.instructions: The aggregate cannot hold the permanent approved Type I entry pointer without a business outcome fact on TypeIEntryDecisionRecorded.

criteria.true: The reducer cannot know whether an entry was approved without reading content.
criteria.false: The pointer can be held from existing event fields.

disposition.instructions: An owner decision gating a business outcome (Type I entry approved) is a domain fact. What should be done about the missing outcome on the event?

criteria.add_to_model: Register an outcome business field on TypeIEntryDecisionRecorded in the catalog.
criteria.remove: Drop the permanent approved pointer from the model.
